test_title: PYST 21: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 18 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means 'A is the sister of B',

A-B means 'A is the brother of B',

A x B means 'A is the wife of B' and

A ÷ B means 'A is the father of B'.

How is F related to Y if ‘F – H x L ÷ O + Y’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷ 
 
 

 Meaning
 Sister
 Brother
 Wife
 Father
 
 

 

Given: F- H x L+ O +Y

It means:

F is the Brother of H 

H is the Wife of L 

L is the Father of O

O is the Sister of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02ecc9e242ac0d420398264cd1a4971d4ed23f1d9c9d6d8bbfe22107d4b5a391.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f2d77b307ced921e3f0cceeb6c4c5316ac68cd877b9507a75503b0d12ab0da4.png] 

So, F is the '**Mother's brother**' of Y.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
